text:
alex: Heads-up — we should standardize how SDKs and the Console surface "quota exceeded" so customers can fallback gracefully.

maya: +1. Current SDKs just bubble a bland 429 with no actionable hint. customers keep asking: retry? switch key? degrade? :confused: 

jon: Can we include a structured hint in the error payload instead of free text? e.g. 
```json
{
  "error": "quota_exceeded",
  "error_code": "quota.exceeded.burst",
  "quota_scope": "org",             // or "key"
  "retry_after": 15,                    // seconds
  "recommended_action": "reduce_batch_size|use-cache|switch-model"
}
```
That makes SDKs and the Console programmatic.

maya: Love the structured fields. One security note: do NOT expose org internal IDs in responses. quota_scope should be a token like "org"/"key" not an org identifier.

leah: UX ask — Console should show a quick CTA in the failure banner: "View quota details" and a link to the route-level quota page + the sample fix (reduce concurrency, enable caching). Avoid long error dumps.

docs-jen: I can update docs if we lock the schema. A couple of edge decisions:
- name for error_code namespace (quota.exceeded.* vs limits.*)
- whether retry_after is mandatory for burst throttles

alex: Proposal: error_code = "quota.exceeded.*". retry_after present when server-side throttle is time-bound (burst). For permanent limit (monthly quota) include "quota_reset": "2026-04-01T00:00:00Z" as ISO string.

jon: Implementation note for SDKs: respect `recommended_action` vector. We can map to local policy: 
- reduce batch size -> halve tokens per request
- use-cache -> check local prefix cache
- switch-model -> fallback to cheaper model id
SDKs should emit telemetry events when they act on a recommendation.

maya: Also add `quota_available` numeric field? Customers want to show a local gauge. But that might be noisy and confusing at scale. Maybe Console only, SDK optional opt-in telemetry.

leah: For Console error banner, we should show: friendly line, one-liner reason (burst vs sustained), remaining tokens OR hint to billing page, and the single button "View fixes" linking to docs. Keep copy short. Example: "Usage spike: requests temporarily throttled. Try backing off or enabling prefix cache. View fixes."

jon: Ops/capacity question: when router falls back to cheaper model automatically, should response include `fallback_model` in the error? Might be useful for observability.

maya: If we include `fallback_model`, stick to model name only (no internal instance IDs). Also log routed path in telemetry not in client error to avoid info leakage.

docs-jen: I'll draft the docs page for the new error JSON + SDK migration guide. Need final schema and the console copy.

alex: Rollout plan:
1) server: implement error v2 behind feature flag `quota-error-v2` (returns structured fields)
2) SDKs: add parsing + recommended_action handlers; opt-in telemetry for acting on recommendations
3) Console: show new banner and "View fixes" modal linking to docs
4) Gradual canary for 1% -> 25% -> 100% (route-by-route)

leah: add to product roadmap and track as "quota-ux-2". Also add a small AB test on copy to measure support ticket rate.

jon: Tests: unit tests for schema, e2e with sample throttle responses, and a regression in telemetry pipeline (new event names).

maya: One more: ensure we include `Retry-After` header for HTTP 429 responses for clients that rely on standard semantics. The JSON `retry_after` is additive (programmatic).

alex: Agreed. `Retry-After` + `retry_after` in body. Also add a stable error_code for docs linking: https://docs.redwood.ai/api/errors#quota-exceeded (docs stub).

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature-flag `quota-error-v2` created by alex.001, will be available in staging in ~10m :rocket:.

leah: OK, thanks all. @docs-jen please ping when you have the first draft. i'll create the console task and assign to design. :thumbsup:

docs-jen: will do. tagging the SDK leads next.

alex: tl;dr: structured error payload with error_code, quota_scope (no org ids), retry_after + Retry-After header, recommended_action vector, optional quota_available, console CTA + docs. We'll roll behind `quota-error-v2` flag and update SDKs/docs accordingly.

maya: +1. moving to implementation checklist.
